firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore data structure is designed to support the Luxe Locks Boutique application, focusing on user accounts, product catalog, and shopping cart functionality. The structure prioritizes authorization independence and predictable security rules.

`/users/{userId}`: Stores user profile data. Access is restricted to the user themselves. This structure enforces path-based ownership, ensuring users can only read and write their own data.

`/products/{productId}`: Stores product information. This collection is publicly readable, allowing all users to view the product catalog.  Write access should be restricted to authorized admin users (role-based access control to be implemented via a separate mechanism, such as Cloud Functions).

`/users/{userId}/cart_items/{cartItemId}`: Stores cart items associated with a specific user. This subcollection enforces ownership via the path, enabling simple security rules where users can only manage items within their own carts. Each `cartItem` contains the `productId`, so all necessary data to render the cart can be retrieved with a collection group query.
